description: Read native-coin balances within the connected session. Requires an active session — call connect first. Omit `chains` to sweep every granted chain; pass `chains` (CAIP-2 ids or numeric chain ids) to read specific granted chains. `account` defaults to the connected wallet address.

account.description: Account address to query. Defaults to the connected wallet address.

chains.description: Chains to read as CAIP-2 ids ("eip155:1") or numeric chain ids. Omit to read every granted chain.

name: get_balance
title: Get balance
